title: pvproSTARSTARCDReader
body:
## pvproSTARSTARCDReader

Reads a proSTAR (STAR-CD) mesh stored as ASCII .vrt (vertices) and .cel (cells) files with a common base name into an unstructured grid; pass either file. ScaleFactor multiplies all coordinates, e.g. 0.001 to convert a millimetre mesh to metres. Only geometry is read, not solution fields.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Both .vrt and .cel files must be present with the same base name.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `proSTARSTARCDReader`. Identity: `sources/ProStarReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | Set the file name for the proSTAR (STARCD) reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ScaleFactor` | Scaling factor for the points | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvproSTARSTARCDReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
